patterns.what_worked: Surgical wrapper edits: the rogue body was wrapped without re-indenting or reformatting; activation placed in init_libs before post_init; order pinned by a loader that installs the hooks, so a wrong order leaves no post_init hook. All 10 mutation proofs fail the owning suite.
patterns.what_was_hard: Six shared suites load classes/rogue.lua and assert on its body; they needed the generic loader activation (combined brief R5) to keep the harness green. The toc_check local guard now measures the wrapper (3) instead of the body closure (71) - filed with the exact fix, not edited.
patterns.skill_gap: First edit raced a parallel shell append on the same file (the closing end was lost); re-applied sequentially and verified with luac. Rule for next time: never touch the same file from two calls in one block.

escalation.recommendation: A2: wrap the other five class files, add the all-six proof suite, and decide whether Auto + a missing supported module should print the fail-closed line (A1 only notices an explicit pick or a throwing loader). Apply the filed toc_check max-locals fix.
